<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Improved Elemental Blast](/Feats.aspx?ID=4337) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 57

**Archetype** [Kineticist](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=206)

**Prerequisites**
[Kineticist Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4333)

</column>

---

The power of your [elemental blast](/Actions.aspx?ID=2125) improves. The damage of your elemental blast increases by one die.

**Special** You can take Improved Elemental Blast a second time at 14th level to increase your Elemental Blast to three damage die, and a third time at 18th level to increase your Elemental Blast to four damage die.
name: Improved Elemental Blast
